dialog.description: A provider is a logical backend plus its price. Add one instance per physical endpoint.
dialog.costHint: The price this gateway actually pays per search. Self-hosted SearXNG should be the amortized cost — (server + bandwidth + ops) / searches per month — which typically lands near 0.0001, not the 0.01 default. Filling in 0 makes the cost invisible in reports; it does not mean the search was free.
dialog.costPlaceholderWarning: This looks like the industry list price ($10/1k), not a self-hosted amortized cost. Keeping it overstates spend by roughly 50x — confirm this is the price you meant.
dialog.failoverOrderHint: Lower runs first. The smallest non-null value is the default provider, which cannot be deleted.
dialog.costInvalid: Cost must be a non-negative number
dialog.enabledHint: A disabled provider keeps its settings but serves no requests.
